basis: Using the dashboard's labeled rating-share values (the designated evidence source), the printed percentages for the available options are Price = 49% (chart_1, Price point), Support = 33% (chart_1, Support point), and Design = 30% (chart_1, Design point). Comparing these, Price has the greatest current labeled rating share (49% > 33% and 49% > 30%). The rule requires selecting the category with the highest current labeled rating share.
